purpose: Every result in this project comes from a two-option forced choice, which invites the objection that the saturation finding is an artefact of a degenerate task. This reruns the load-bearing checks on a four-option variant. Chance favouring falls from 0.50 to 0.25, so the behavioural test is strictly harder; the activations are read from a different distribution of user messages, so a saturation result that survives is not a property of the binary format.
verdict: SATURATED on the four-option task as well: a pair that should be inseparable reaches AUROC 1.000. The saturation result is not an artefact of the binary forced choice.
